title: Perrin's mother explicitly asked 'Tell me true, whatever you find. I'd rather know than keep hoping blind,' but resolving Perrin's own arc at Highward ('cover his wavering, quietly') closed the 'Perrin's Mother' quest instantly with no prompt, travel hook, or dialogue to actually deliver word back to her in Reedholm. The end-of-game status recap (which name-checks dozens of other minor NPCs' fates) never mentions her again either.
where: The Barracks (Highward) / talk to Perrin -> 'cover his wavering, quietly'; quest 'Perrin's Mother'
